screens.why: Opening: Play screen, candles, broom over Hogwarts, glowing wave. Gorgeous hook, but 12-14 s before I learn whose site this is.
Big blackletter name over the glowing sea; clear who it is. Tagline and sub-line are tiny next to the name.
Iris opens on the Black Pearl. Striking, and curiosity carries me, but it's a movie still held ~6 s with nothing about him.
'A research journal in four acts' with a contents list. Gives me a map; the cropped image band at the top looks off.
'A builder of quantitative systems.' Finally substance: bio plus 4 values. Dense 3-column body text.
'How the methodology was earned.' Story hook, harbour image, small journey map.
Trading alongside my father; the sticky image swaps scenes. Feels alive.
Pine Script attempts and 'They failed out of sample.' Honest failure is a strong hook.
Journey ends, then '3 IDIOTS' over a thin sea strip low on a mostly empty dark frame. Momentum dips; another movie?
Torn-paper wipe into the lecture hall with a drone on the chalkboard. A real 'oh nice' moment.
Ghost 'The Workshop', then giant cropped 'Dor' letters, then two half-images stacked with dark gaps. Looks glitchy.
Astronaut pen photo, 'Led by what survived scrutiny.' writes itself in. Strong line.
Seven-part validation gauntlet on the chalkboard. Concrete process, which is what an engineer wants.
Flagship 'Quantitative Trading Research' with the corridor photo. The first real project.
Blue 'Rancho-style blueprint' diagram plus key numbers. Scannable.
'What is a machine?' chalkboard bridge. Playful.
Second project, 'Automated Strategy Research Pipeline'. Substance, though the layout repeats project 1.
Same blue blueprint and same corridor photo again, then a tail of tiny text. Seen it.
'See the thesis, not just read it.' A chart draws itself with a toggle. Invites a click.
Chart finishes; the drone photo pops in bright daylight, a good contrast break.
'What I can actually do.' Skills map; recruiters want this, but the table text is tiny.
Rest of the skills table: a wall of tiny text on a dark, mostly empty screen.
'The kill-list': a list of killed ideas is a good concept. The pen photo is reused from screen 11.
Ten-plus dim, tiny list rows scroll by like a log. Skim fatigue.
'Three films and a game' in plain grey sans on an empty black screen for ~4 s. Dead air, and the font changes.
Black Pearl again (seen on screen 2). Seen it.
Quote plus paragraph; the film-card formula repeats.
Bright yellow scooter at Pangong lake: a fresh palette that wakes me up.
Blood-red RDR2 plate, 'Be loyal to what matters.' The colour shift holds me.
Hogwarts Express plus a golden glint flitting across: is that a Snitch? Curious.
Sepia photo 'develops' inside a frame; the glint again. A neat effect.
Same RDR2 sunset held ~6 s; captions overlap; '...rontier' then giant cropped '01' letters look broken.
The same sunset appears twice on screen, then again behind 'Discipline, service, and a trained eye.' Third time.
'Discipline, in three arenas': dense mono text on brown.
More mono paragraphs next to the same sunset. Wall of text.
'Training the eye': still the same sunset; I'm skimming now.
Satchel inventory icons, then a WANTED poster with his name. Fun, and I'd screenshot it.
Page turns to cream journal paper with pencil sketches: a welcome refresh.
Essay titles marked 'soon' or draft. Nothing to read yet.
More draft titles; a stray grey arc smears across the page.
'In their words.' A warm campfire plate and a real testimonial: social proof.
Second and third quotes in small mono; long and hard to read.
A glowing ring burns through the campfire into the Great Hall, with the snitch. Best transition on the page.
The Great Hall shrinks and the Marauder's Map unfolds. Lovely, despite the cropped 'THE LIGH' title.
'A small philosophy of work' on the map with footprints walking. Charming, but held ~10 s.
Five ornate principle cards with tiny body text; it drags.
Last card gives way to floating candles: contact is coming.
'Let's talk research, markets, or building systems...' Clear CTA with an email pill.
Film-style credits in tiny dim type. I'd close the tab here.
'Mischief managed.' on an almost empty black screen. Dead end.
Same cinematic opening; Play screen copy readable at this width. ~11 s before the name.
Name over the glowing sea, with the bracket reticle on the ship. Clear.
Iris reveal of the Black Pearl. Striking, if long.
Faint ghost 'The Crossing', then the ship cut to a box and the act list. Useful map; the cut is abrupt.
'A builder of quantitative systems.' The substance arrives.
The 3 columns get narrow and long at 1024: a wall of small serif text.
'How the methodology was earned.' with the journey map. Hook.
Pine Script story; the sticky image keeps changing.
'They failed out of sample', the methodology, then the 3 IDIOTS title. Honest and moving.
The paper-burn wipe shows a flat pale-cyan blank panel with a hard rectangular notch. Looks like a failed load.
Lecture hall and chalkboard drone; then the 'The Workshop' ghost and a giant cropped 'Wor'.
Two half-images stacked with dark gaps while scrolling; jumpy and unclear.
'Led by what survived scrutiny.' Strong line.
Seven-part gauntlet chalkboard. Concrete.
Flagship project with the corridor and blueprint.
Blueprint diagram and numbers. Scannable.
Stats, then the 'What is a machine?' chalkboard.
Second project intro.
The same blue blueprint panel again.
The same corridor photo again beside tiny stats. Seen it.
'See the thesis' heading holds while the chart sits mostly below the fold; an empty card.
Chart draws with the naive/realistic toggle. Want to click.
Drone photo with a 'Take off' pill; 'What I can actually do.'
Skills table: tiny, dense text.
'The kill-list' with a Dead Eye pill. Good concept.
Dim list rows; an unexplained thin outline box.
More list rows, then empty dark.
'Three films and a game' alone on a black screen for ~5 s.
Black Pearl again.
Yellow scooter, bright and fresh.
Red RDR2 plate slides in; the colour pop works.
Dead Eye marks on the red plate, then the Harry Potter title writes in.
Hogwarts Express; a glint drifts across into the RDR2 frame.
Sepia photo develops, then the same sunset held ~6 s, then '...rontier'. Slow.
Giant cropped 'ron' letters, then the same sunset duplicated below itself.
Third use of the sunset behind 'Discipline, service...'.
Map sketch plus mono paragraphs on brown.
'Continuing a family legacy': more mono text, same image.
'Training the eye'; satchel icons are faint.
WANTED poster with his name. Memorable.
Cream journal page: a visual reset.
Draft essay titles marked 'soon'.
More draft titles.
Fade into the campfire; 'In their words.' arrives.
Teacher testimonial over the camp. Social proof.
Second testimonial in small mono; long.
Burn-ring transition into the Great Hall. Best moment.
Map unfolds (after a cropped 'The Light' mask).
Marauder's Map philosophy, charming; long hold (~8 s).
Principle cards with tiny body text.
More cards; it drags.
Contact CTA, email pill, 'Open in your mail app', GitHub. Clear.
Mostly empty dark screen before the credits roll.
'Mischief managed.' on black. End.

acts.act: Opening + hero (play screen, broom flight, name)
acts.feel: Beautiful and cinematic, but 12-14 s of film before the name; a recruiter starts tapping. The name lands hard when it comes.

acts.act: Act I: The Crossing (Pirates, contents, about, journey)
acts.feel: The best-paced stretch: the iris reveal, a clear contents list, then about and an honest failure story with a sticky image that keeps changing.

acts.act: Act II: The Workshop (3 Idiots: work, two projects, experiment, skills, kill-list)
acts.feel: Lots of cuts and good material (gauntlet, blueprints, chart, drone), but it sags whenever it repeats a picture (corridor, blueprint, pen) or drops into tiny text tables.

acts.act: Intermission: Three films and a game
acts.feel: Opens on dead air, then turns into pretty film cards. The scooter and red plate wake you up; the card formula is predictable by the third one.

acts.act: Act III: The Frontier (RDR2: beyond, satchel, wanted, writing, voices)
acts.feel: The low point. The same sunset photo carries ~5 screens of mono text. The WANTED poster and journal page are the only spikes, and the writing is all 'soon'.

acts.act: Act IV: The Light (Great Hall, Marauder's map principles, contact)
acts.feel: Starts with the best transition on the page and a lovely map, then slows on five principle cards before a clear contact CTA.
Tiny credits fading into an empty black screen. Fine as a coda, but nobody busy will see it.

findings.finding: Act-title image-in-text reveals read as broken half-words: giant cropped 'Dor'/'Wor', '...rontier' then '01'/'ron', 'THE LIGH'. Three times per width, each at an act break.
The 3 Idiots paper-burn wipe shows a flat pale-cyan blank panel (with a hard rectangular notch at top right) for ~1.5 s. Looks like an image failed to load.

The RDR2 golden-hour photo is used back to back (film card, Act III card, 'Discipline' hero, sticky on Beyond). In 1440 #83 2:44 and 1024 #77 2:32 two copies are on screen at once. The biggest 'seen it' stretch.
Caption 'GOLDEN HOUR IN THE HEARTLANDS / RED DEAD REDEMPTION 2' overlaps the incoming 'The Frontier' paragraph: text on text.
Lecture hall leaving and astronaut pen arriving: two half-images stacked with dark gaps between. Reads as a layout hiccup, not a designed cut.
'Three films and a game' sits alone in plain grey sans on an empty black screen for 4-5 s: dead air, and visually off-brand next to the display faces.
Ghost 'The Crossing' title over the ship is dark-on-dark and barely legible: a smudge, not a title.
Long runs of tiny, dim mono or sans text (skills table, kill-list rows, Beyond paragraphs, second testimonial, credits) are hard to read at scroll speed and hard to tell apart from texture.
The 'See the thesis' heading stop happens with the chart still below the fold: the reader pauses on a heading and an empty card.
~12-14 s of opening film before the name, then a further ~6 s on a movie still. A busy visitor gets nothing about the person in the first 25 s except the name and one tagline.
The page ends on near-empty black screens (credits rolling in tiny type, then 'Mischief managed.'). A dead end after a good contact CTA.
A thin outlined vertical rectangle floats next to the first kill-list row. It looks like an empty placeholder box.
A stray grey arc stroke sweeps across the journal page as it scrolls out.
Both projects use the same corridor photo and the same blue blueprint panel, so project 2 feels like a rerun. Black Pearl (s2 to s25) and the astronaut pen (s11 to s22) are reused too.

Typeface whiplash: blackletter, handwriting, plain grey sans, slab western, mono and small-caps serif. The plain-sans blocks ('See the thesis', 'Three films and a game') look unfinished next to the rest. The testimonials switch from italic serif to mono.
clips-panel.json shows the capture frame rate falling to 3.6-6 fps here (p95 frame gaps of 230-570 ms). On a real laptop that would likely show as stutter in Act I and the map or contact section.
The '3 IDIOTS' title and a thin sea strip hang low in an otherwise empty dark frame before the torn-paper reveal.

note: Screen 0 = the opening clips labelled 'opening' (before screen 1). Judged only from the listed contact sheets, clips-panel.json and the static 1024 scene sheets.
